psim.title: psim
psim.shortDescription: A real-time Pokemon Showdown battle assistant — live damage calculations, opponent tracking, and a teambuilder, all from the terminal.
psim.description: A terminal-based Pokemon Showdown battle assistant that connects directly to PS via WebSocket and overlays live information during a battle. Damage calculations run through a Python-to-Node.js bridge that calls @smogon/calc — the same engine used by the official Smogon damage calculator. Built for competitive formats including Random Battles, VGC, and BSS.
features: WebSocket client that connects to Pokemon Showdown and parses the PS protocol in real time
Cross-language damage calculation: Python spawns Node.js to run @smogon/calc, reverse-engineering EVs from PS-reported stats
Live HUD overlay showing damage ranges colour-coded by KO threat (OHKO, 2HKO, neutral)
Battle state tracker for field conditions — weather, terrain, Tailwind, screens, Tera type, and stat boosts
Opponent tracker logging seen moves, items, abilities, HP percentages, and status across turns
Teambuilder with full Smogon dex lookup for species, moves, items, and abilities
Player stats fetching from the PS public API (Elo, GXE, W/L)
Multi-format support: Random Battles (level-adjusted), VGC/BSS (Lv50), and standard formats

chatProject.title: Chat Project
chatProject.shortDescription: A self-hostable, real-time communication platform — a customizable alternative to Discord and Slack with text, audio, video, and screen-sharing channels.
chatProject.description: A full-stack real-time communication platform designed as a customizable, self-hostable alternative to Discord and Slack for teams and communities. Built with hierarchical server and channel management, granular role-based permissions, live audio, video, and screen-sharing via LiveKit, and a full admin dashboard for user moderation.
features: Designed as a self-hostable alternative to Discord and Slack — fully customizable for any team or community
Server creation with invite links and role-based member management (Admin, Moderator, Guest)
Text, audio, video, and screen-sharing channels powered by LiveKit
Direct messaging and one-on-one video calls between members
Admin dashboard with full user oversight — view any user's message history, suspend or reactivate accounts
File and image attachments via UploadThing
Message editing and deletion with real-time updates across all connected clients
Infinite scroll with cursor-based pagination for message history
Fully responsive UI with dark and light mode support

jumpCat.title: JumpCat
jumpCat.shortDescription: A self-contained Paper API plugin with four competitive minigames, team management, and persistent stats — zero external dependencies.
jumpCat.description: A comprehensive Minecraft minigames plugin built on Paper API 1.21, designed to run as a single self-contained plugin. No external database or addon dependencies — everything needed for a competitive multiplayer server in one package.
features: Twelve color-coded teams with friendly-fire disabled and team-chat toggle
Persistent points economy with paginated leaderboards and per-player tracking
Sidebar HUD displaying kills, deaths, rank, and team status
Floating text-display leaderboard signs for player or team rankings
Dynamic MOTD reflecting the current game state
Automatic world cloning from templates with post-game cleanup
Particle-wall border with configurable damage-per-second that shrinks over time
In-memory moderation tools (ban, mute, kick with optional duration support)
